product_wide_rationale: Governs the session's persistent worktree target and the product-wide authority tiers for cross-worktree access. It amends session-target authority without assigning ownership to a runtime Domain.
summary: Amends CD-0093 D2 so a running session may create or claim its current work item's canonical worktree and persistently retarget later Concord operations to it while the host process directory stays unchanged. Same-Project cross-worktree access is tiered: read-only Inspect, exclusive-lease Verify with unchanged tracked files, typed-transfer Take over, and Destroy limited to merged terminal work or operator approval. Targets derive from registered Project and work identity, possession grants no Product authority, and continuity re-pins the target and lease each turn with stale versions failing closed.
title: Allow in-session worktree retargeting under tiered authority
